file_stem: RWB E1 043 Reference data service with versioned tables
title: Reference data service with versioned tables
status_text: Ready. Business-date check waits for ACE-001
goal: 12 reference tables versioned with author, approver and dates, so values change by data release
why: Products, regions, queues, service levels and limits all change. One registry decides which version is in force on a date; holidays come from ACE instead.

ace.note: not served here: holidays are read by E1-028

writes.note: header: table, version, valid_from, author, approver
the rows of each version (append only)

reads.note: version in force for a date

stores: In-memory ReferenceRowCache (refdata.cache.ttl-seconds); engine log line per table read; daily DQ report (E1-011)

functions.name: ReferenceDataServiceImpl
functions.does: version in force for a date

functions.name: ReferenceVersionLogger
functions.does: one log line per table read

rules: BR1: 12 tables: PRODUCT, REGION, EXPOSURE_BAND, ROLE, TEAM, QUEUE, SERVICE_LEVEL ... (no holiday)
BR3: in force = approved version with the latest valid_from <= the date
BR4: the approver is never the author
BR9: no version in force -> the engine does not run
risks: Approved by the author -> stays VALIDATED (MSG-P7-002)
Row fails the table schema -> refused (MSG-P3-027)
No version in force -> engine stops and alerts (MSG-P3-027)
example: U-REF-01 loads v4 (E1-E5) from 2026-12-01; U-RSK-01 approves
A read for 2026-11-30 returns v3, whose valid_to is now 2026-11-30
